text:
Sofia: Ok team — planning a short partner workbench demo next Wed to show our onramp templates + Terraform modules for a cloud partner. Need owners for: demo env, quickstart scripts, slides, and CI smoketests. Thoughts?
Marco: I can own the demo env (GCP partner region). Need exact infra shape and any partner-specific VPC peering info. @Anika can you confirm templates we should reuse?
Anika: Happy to help. Can we standardize on the new iac-stub repo? link: https://git.redwood.dev/partner-workbench/iac-stub — it has starter modules and a sample overlay.
Ravi: I’ll draft quickstart scripts + prereq checklist. For CI, do we prefer GitHub Actions or partner CI pipelines? I lean GH Actions for the demo.
devex-bot: Reminder: doc template 'partner-onramp-template.md' exists at /docs/devex/partner-onramp-template.md
Sofia: Great. Marco — can you provision a dev cluster and post the preview URL? Need it by Tue EOD so we can dry-run.
Marco: On it. Will spin up a small cluster (2x a1.small + 1x control) in the partner region. ETA Tue 3pm. Will post creds in the private partner channel.
Anika: For Terraform modules, let's ensure multi-arch instance mapping and an AMI lookup helper. Small snippet to include in module README:
```
module "compute" {
  source = "git::https://git.redwood.dev/modules/compute.git"
  vars = { arch_map = { x86 = "c5.large" arm = "t4g.medium" } }
}
```
Ravi: Nice. I'll wire that into quickstart.sh and add a smoke test job template for GH Actions: 
```
name: partner-smoke
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: ./quickstart.sh --verify
```
Sofia: :thumbsup: Are we aligned on messaging for the partner? I want a 5-slide deck focused on easy onramp, predictable perf in partner region, and reproducible infra.
Anika: I can sketch the slides. Will include a mini-arch diagram, list of prebuilt modules, and a table of expected latency/cost tradeoffs.
devex-bot: Preview environment created: https://preview.redwood.dev/p/3742001111 — expires in 7 days.
Marco: Preview looks good from my side. Shared with invited partner accounts and our SEs.
Ravi: Setting up GH Actions workflow now, adding the smoke job and a deploy preview step. Will ping when green.
Sofia: Thanks all. If no blockers, let's convene a dry run Tue 10am. @Ravi @Marco @Anika please RSVP.
Marco: Yes, I'll be there.
Anika: Yes.
Ravi: Yep, see you then.
